description: High-performance AST-based template parser for .NET with HTML-like syntax, component system, layouts, slots, and enterprise-grade security. Cross-platform compatible with .NET Standard 2.0, .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 6.0+, and .NET 8.0+.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.24 - CRITICAL: Nested Component Callback Fix (January 2026)
- FIX: Callback SetVariable now works correctly for nested components (Block > Element)
- FIX: engine.SetVariable() in callback syncs to child evaluator's variables
- FIX: Param interpolation like "left-shape {{element.Class}}" now resolves correctly
- Callback-set variables (element, attributes) are now available during param resolution
- Fixed collection modification error during variable sync

v1.0.23 - Consolidated Fixes (January 2026)
- FIX: Comma (,) and colon (:) now allowed in Param values
- Enables comma-separated lists in params (e.g., properties="Title,Description,ImagePath")
- No longer throws "Unsafe expression detected" for valid comma-separated values
- Security: Comma/colon are safe characters for expression evaluation

v1.0.21 - Param Processing Bug Fix (January 2026)
- FIX: Params like class, imageurl, etc. now correctly processed alongside callback-set variables
- FIX: Interpolation in Param values (e.g., "left-shape {{element.Class}}") now works correctly
- Only NEWLY ADDED variables by callback skip Param processing (not existing variables)
- Callback SetVariable priority feature still works for new variables

v1.0.20 - Callback SetVariable Priority (January 2026)
- NEW: SetVariable() in OnBeforeIncludeRender callback now takes priority over Param values
- FIX: Callback-set variables no longer overwritten by Param processing
- Enables dynamic attribute injection from callback (e.g., adding data-* attributes)
- Optimized: No allocation overhead when callback not configured
- Example: engine.SetVariable("attributes", "data-custom='value'") in callback now works correctly

v1.0.19 - RenderBlock Method (January 2026)
- NEW: engine.RenderBlock(block) - renders BlockInfo with automatic callbacks
- Fires OnBeforeIncludeRender for parent block (not just nested components)
- Auto-sets variables from block.Parameters
- Fires OnAfterIncludeRender for output wrapping
- Clean API: replace RenderFile loop with single RenderBlock call

v1.0.18 - Callback Timing Fix (January 2026)
- FIX: OnBeforeIncludeRender now fires BEFORE component load
- Callback works even if component file doesn't exist
- Enables data fetching in callback for Data/Block/Element/Nav tags
- ComponentType correctly passed: "data", "block", "element", "navigation"

v1.0.17 - BlockInfo.Parameters Compatibility (January 2026)
- CHANGE: BlockInfo.Parameters now Dictionary<string, object>
- Works directly with engine.SetVariables(block.Parameters)
- No casting required
- Better error messages with full path info

v1.0.16 - RenderFile Folder Support (January 2026)
- NEW: RenderFile() now supports folder-based components
- folder → folder/default.html (like LoadComponent)
- Priority: file.html → file + .html → folder/default.html
- Works with both components and pages directories

v1.0.15 - OldName Parsing Fix (January 2026)
- FIX: BlockInfo.OldName now correctly parsed from template
- Template format: <Block component="x" name="y" oldname="z">
- Improved attribute parsing (supports any attribute order)

v1.0.14 - BlockParser Performance & OldName (January 2026)
- NEW: Static caching for best performance (no file change detection)
- NEW: BlockInfo.OldName property for tracking renames
- NEW: BlockParser.ClearCache() - clear all cached blocks
- NEW: BlockParser.ClearCache(path) - clear specific page cache
- NEW: BlockParser.CacheCount - get cached page count
- Cache is shared across all BlockParser instances

v1.0.13 - BlockParser Improvement (January 2026)
- BlockParser now accepts TemplateEngine in constructor
- ParseBlocks(pageName) - uses PagesDirectory automatically
- NEW: TemplateEngine.PagesDirectory property (public getter)
- NEW: TemplateEngine.ComponentsDirectory property (public getter)
- NEW: TemplateEngine.LayoutsDirectory property (public getter)
- No need to specify full path anymore!

v1.0.12 - BlockParser: Page Template Block Extraction (January 2026)
- NEW: BlockParser class for parsing Block-based page templates
- NEW: BlockInfo model for storing block information in database
- ParseBlocks(templatePath, pageName) - Extract blocks from template file
- ParseBlocksFromContent(content, pageName) - Extract blocks from string
- Extracts: Name, ComponentPath, Order, Parameters
- Perfect for CMS: Store block config in DB, render from component files
- No database code included - integrate with your own EF/database

v1.0.11 - Template Fragments: Define & Render (January 2026)
- NEW: <Define name="fragmentName"> for inline template fragment definition
- NEW: <Render name="fragmentName" param1="value1" /> for fragment rendering
- Enables inline recursion without separate component files
- Perfect for multi-level navigation menus, tree structures
- Parameters passed via attributes, supports variable interpolation
- Security: Respects MaxRecursionDepth limit (default: 20)
- FIX: If condition now properly evaluates collections (non-empty = true, empty = false)
- FIX: Objects are truthy in conditions, null is falsy

v1.0.10 - HTML Tag Case-Sensitivity Fix (January 2026)
- FIX: HTML lowercase tags like section, data, nav are now preserved as-is
- Template tags MUST be PascalCase (Section, Data, Nav, Element, Block, etc.)
- This allows section wrapper around Data component without issues
- Example: section class="x" with Data component="slider" inside now works

v1.0.9 - Security Path Auto-Registration (January 2026)
- FIX: SetComponentsDirectory/SetPagesDirectory now auto-registers paths for security validation
- Paths with spaces now work correctly
- No more "Template path failed security validation" errors

v1.0.8 - Pages Directory Support
- SetPagesDirectory() - Configure separate directory for page templates
- RenderPage() - Render page templates directly
- RenderFile(path, isPage) - Flag to choose between components/pages directory

v1.0.7 - Type-Specific Component Tags
- Type-Specific Tags - Element, Block, Data, Nav with auto path prefix
- OnAfterIncludeRender callback - fires after component renders for wrapping
- ComponentType property in IncludeInfo

v1.0.6 - OnBeforeIncludeRender Event
v1.0.5 - Pre-Render Data Extraction
v1.0.0 - Initial Release
